sections.heading: The Big Decision
paragraphs: One of the first decisions you'll make as a founder is choosing your business structure. This choice impacts everything from taxes to fundraising to personal liability.
Getting this right from the start saves you significant time and money down the road.

sections.heading: Common Business Structures in India
paragraphs: Best for: Freelancers, small service providers
Best for: Professional services, family businesses
Best for: Professional services, consulting firms
Best for: Startups looking to scale, raise funding
1. Sole Proprietorship
2. Partnership Firm
3. Limited Liability Partnership (LLP)
4. Private Limited Company ⭐

sections.heading: Quick Comparison
paragraphs: Factor | Proprietorship | Partnership | LLP | Pvt Ltd
Liability Protection | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅
VC/Angel Funding | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅
Compliance Cost | Low | Low | Medium | High
Best For | Solo | 2+ Partners | Services | Scalable Startups

sections.heading: Our Recommendation
paragraphs: If you're building a startup that might raise funding: Go with Private Limited Company . The extra compliance is worth the flexibility.
If you're a service business with partners: LLP offers good protection with lower compliance.

sections.heading: Pro Tips
paragraphs: You can always convert from one structure to another later, but it's easier to start right.
💡 You can always convert from one structure to another later, but it's easier to start right.

sections.heading: Step-by-Step Incorporation Guide
paragraphs: For a Private Limited Company, the process is now streamlined via the SPICe+ (Simplified Proforma for Incorporating Company Electronically Plus) portal.
• Step 1: Obtain DSC (Digital Signature Certificate) for all proposed directors.
• Step 2: Reserve Company Name through the RUN (Reserve Unique Name) service.
• Step 3: Draft MoA and AoA (Memorandum and Articles of Association).
• Step 4: File SPICe+ Form for Incorporation, DIN, PAN, and TAN.
• Step 5: Get Certificate of Incorporation from the ROC.

sections.heading: Estimated Costs
paragraphs: Item | Cost (Approx.)
DSC (2 Directors) | ₹2,000 - ₹3,000
Name Approval (RUN) | ₹1,000
Govt. Stamp Duty | Varies by State (₹2,000 - ₹10,000)
Professional Fees | ₹5,000 - ₹15,000

sections.heading: Expected Timeline
paragraphs: The timeline largely depends on how quickly name approval and document verification by the ROC happens.
Typical Duration: 7 to 15 Working Days

sections.heading: Expert tips
paragraphs: Choose at least 2 unique names for reservation to avoid rejection. Avoid generic words like 'Global', 'Solutions', or 'Technologies' as names.
💡 Choose at least 2 unique names for reservation to avoid rejection. Avoid generic words like 'Global', 'Solutions', or 'Technologies' as names.

sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
paragraphs: • Entity must be a Pvt Ltd, LLP, or Partnership.
• Registered for less than 10 years.
• Turnover under ₹100 Crores in any financial year.
• Working towards innovation or improvement of products/services.

sections.heading: How to Apply
paragraphs: Register on the Startup India Hub and submit the application for DPIIT (formerly DIPP) recognition with a brief write-up on your startup's innovative nature.
Make sure your "innovation statement" clearly highlights how you are solving a problem or making a process better.
💡 Make sure your "innovation statement" clearly highlights how you are solving a problem or making a process better.

sections.heading: The Shop & Establishment License
paragraphs: Regulated by state governments, this license (commonly called Gumasta in some states) is mandatory for any commercial establishment or shop.

sections.heading: Is it Mandatory?
paragraphs: Yes, for almost any physical office or business premise. It's often the first document banks ask for when opening a Current Account if other registrations aren't ready.

sections.heading: Key Regulations Covered
paragraphs: In many states like Karnataka and Delhi, the process is now fully online and yields an e-certificate within days.
💡 In many states like Karnataka and Delhi, the process is now fully online and yields an e-certificate within days.

sections.heading: Understanding Your Business Math
paragraphs: Unit economics tells you if your business model actually works. It's the math behind each transaction that determines if you're building a sustainable business or burning money.

sections.heading: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
paragraphs: What you spend to get one customer
CAC = Total Marketing & Sales Cost \xf7 Number of New Customers

sections.heading: Lifetime Value (LTV)
paragraphs: Total revenue from one customer over time
LTV = Average Revenue per User \xd7 Average Customer Lifetime

sections.heading: The Golden Ratio: LTV/CAC
paragraphs: Ratio | What it means
< 1:1 | 🔴 Losing money on each customer
1:1 to 3:1 | 🟡 Barely profitable, needs work
3:1 to 5:1 | 🟢 Healthy, sustainable business
> 5:1 | 🔵 Great efficiency, scale faster!

sections.heading: Expert tips
paragraphs: LTV should ideally be calculated based on Contribution Margin, not just Revenue.
💡 LTV should ideally be calculated based on Contribution Margin, not just Revenue.

sections.heading: Burn Rate & Runway
paragraphs: Gross Burn: Total cash expenses per month. Net Burn: Difference between expenses and revenue (if revenue < expenses).
Runway: How many months you have before you run out of cash.

sections.heading: Calculating Runway
paragraphs: Runway = Cash in Bank \xf7 Monthly Net Burn

sections.heading: Managing Your Burn
paragraphs: A "safe" runway for a seed-stage startup is usually 18-24 months.
• Automate processes to reduce headcount costs.
• Move to variable costs (freelancers) instead of fixed (full-time).
• Focus on high-margin products/services.
💡 A "safe" runway for a seed-stage startup is usually 18-24 months.

sections.heading: Cash is King, but Profit is Queen
paragraphs: Many profitable businesses fail because they run out of cash. Cash flow is about the timing of money in and out.

sections.heading: What to Track
paragraphs: Always keep a 10-15% buffer in your cash flow projections for unexpected expenses.
• Accounts Receivable (Money coming in).
• Accounts Payable (Bills to pay).
• Tax liabilities (GST, TDS payments).
• Seasonal dips in revenue.
💡 Always keep a 10-15% buffer in your cash flow projections for unexpected expenses.

sections.heading: GST Demystified
paragraphs: GST (Goods and Services Tax) is a unified indirect tax that replaced multiple taxes like VAT, Service Tax, Excise, etc. Understanding GST is crucial for every Indian business.

sections.heading: GST Rates
paragraphs: Category | Rate
Essential items | 0-5%
Standard goods/services | 12-18%
Luxury items | 28%

sections.heading: Input Tax Credit (ITC)
paragraphs: Claim Input Tax Credit (ITC) on everything from laptops to office furniture to reduce your tax bill.
GST Payable = Tax Collected on Sales − Tax Paid on Purchases
💡 Claim Input Tax Credit (ITC) on everything from laptops to office furniture to reduce your tax bill.

sections.heading: Provident Fund (EPF)
paragraphs: EPF is a retirement benefit scheme. The employer and employee both contribute 12% of the basic salary to the EPFO.

sections.heading: Employee State Insurance (ESI)
paragraphs: ESI provides health and social security benefits to employees. It is mandatory for establishments with low-wage employees.

sections.heading: When are they Mandatory?
paragraphs: Even if you have fewer than 20 employees, you can opt for Voluntary PF Registration to provide better benefits to your team.
Scheme | Employee Threshold | Salary Threshold
EPF | 20+ Employees | Up to ₹15,000 basic
ESI | 10+ Employees | Up to ₹21,000 gross
💡 Even if you have fewer than 20 employees, you can opt for Voluntary PF Registration to provide better benefits to your team.

sections.heading: ROC Compliance
paragraphs: Every Private Limited Company must file annual documents with the Registrar of Companies (ROC) to maintain its "Active" status.

sections.heading: The Cost of Delay
paragraphs: Even if your company had zero business during the year, you must file nil returns to avoid massive penalties and director disqualification.
💡 Even if your company had zero business during the year, you must file nil returns to avoid massive penalties and director disqualification.

sections.heading: The Venture Journey
paragraphs: Pre-Seed: Idea/MVP stage. Friends, Family, and Incubators.
Seed: Early traction. Angels and Seed Funds.
Series A: Product-Market Fit. Institutional VCs.

sections.heading: Sources of Capital
paragraphs: • Angel Investors: High-net-worth individuals.
• Venture Capital: Professional money managers.
• Accelerators: Program-based (Y-Combinator, Antler).
• Venture Debt: Non-dilutive capital (Trifecta, Alteria).

sections.heading: What Investors Look For
paragraphs: Fundraising is a full-time job. Expect it to take 3-6 months from pitch to bank transfer.
💡 Fundraising is a full-time job. Expect it to take 3-6 months from pitch to bank transfer.

sections.heading: Equity Shares
paragraphs: Standard ownership shares. Most founders start with these. Dividends and voting rights are tied to these shares.

sections.heading: CCPS (Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares)
paragraphs: The standard instrument for VCs in India. They offer preferential rights (like liquidation preference) and convert to equity at a future date or event.

sections.heading: iSAFE (India Simple Agreement for Future Equity)
paragraphs: Inspired by YC's SAFE, iSAFE is a convertible note that isn't debt. It's an agreement to issue equity during the next funding round.
Convertible notes (like iSAFE) are faster and cheaper to execute for seed rounds because you don't have to fix a valuation immediately.
💡 Convertible notes (like iSAFE) are faster and cheaper to execute for seed rounds because you don't have to fix a valuation immediately.

sections.heading: Valuation Basics
paragraphs: Pre-money Valuation: Value before investment. Post-money Valuation: Pre-money + Investment amount.
Founder Dilution % = Investment \xf7 Post-money Valuation

sections.heading: Veto & Control Rights
paragraphs: Investors often ask for "Affirmative Voting Rights." This means certain decisions (like selling the company or raising more debt) cannot be made without their consent.

sections.heading: Liquidation Preference
paragraphs: Determines who gets paid first during an exit. A 1x Non-participating preference is the founder-friendly market standard.
Never sign a term sheet without a lawyer or a professional consultant reviewing the "small print" on governance and exit clauses.
💡 Never sign a term sheet without a lawyer or a professional consultant reviewing the "small print" on governance and exit clauses.

sections.heading: Copyright
paragraphs: Protects original works of authorship like marketing brochures, website content, and source code. Protection is automatic but registration helps in legal disputes.

sections.heading: Patents
paragraphs: Protects inventions that are new, non-obvious, and useful. Patenting is expensive and take years, but it provides a massive competitive moat.

sections.heading: Can you Patent Software in India?
paragraphs: In India, software per se is not patentable. However, software that produces a "technical effect" or is tied to hardware can often be patented.
Startups get up to 80% rebate on patent filing fees if they are Startup India recognized!
💡 Startups get up to 80% rebate on patent filing fees if they are Startup India recognized!

sections.heading: Structuring for Tax Efficiency
paragraphs: Help your employees take home more by including tax-free components like:
• Standard Deduction (₹50k).
• Professional Tax (varies by state).
• LTA (Leave Travel Allowance).

sections.heading: Expert tips
paragraphs: Don't just offer a high CTC. Explain the "In-hand" vs "CTC" to candidates to manage expectations.
Plan your budget with our Employee Cost Calculator .
💡 Don't just offer a high CTC. Explain the "In-hand" vs "CTC" to candidates to manage expectations.
🔧 Plan your budget with our Employee Cost Calculator .

sections.heading: Employment vs. Retainership
paragraphs: Feature | Employee | Consultant
Compliance | PF, ESI, Gratuity | None (only TDS)
Control | High (work hours, etc) | Low (deliverables based)
Tax (TDS) | Salary Slabs | 10% (Section 194J)

sections.heading: The "Deemed Employee" Risk
paragraphs: If a consultant works exclusively for you, uses your laptop, and follows your work hours, labor courts may treat them as an employee, making you liable for back-dated PF/ESI.

sections.heading: Decision Matrix
paragraphs: Hire as Employee: For core functions (Product, Sales) where you need full-time commitment and control.
Hire as Consultant: For specialized projects (Legal, Design, Research) or temporary needs.

sections.heading: The Long Game
paragraphs: B2B sales in India are relationship-driven and often involve a long sales cycle (3-9 months).
B2B Sales = Trust + ROI + Persistence

sections.heading: Negotiation Tactics
paragraphs: In India, "No" often means "Not right now" or "I need more conviction." Don't give up too early.
• Focus on 'Value' over 'Price'.
• Offer tiered pricing (Basic vs Pro).
• Use case studies from similar Indian firms as social proof.
💡 In India, "No" often means "Not right now" or "I need more conviction." Don't give up too early.

sections.heading: The Power of the Green Bubble
paragraphs: In India, WhatsApp has a 95%+ open rate, compared to ~20% for email. It's where your customers already are.

sections.heading: API vs. Business App
paragraphs: Feature | Business App | Business API (WATI/Interakt)
Scale | Manual / Broadcast lists | Automated / Bulk messages

sections.heading: Don't be a Spammer
paragraphs: If users report your messages as spam, Meta will ban your number. Always include an "Unsubscribe" or "Opt-out" button.
⚠️ If users report your messages as spam, Meta will ban your number. Always include an "Unsubscribe" or "Opt-out" button.

sections.heading: The Micro-Influencer Advantage
paragraphs: Micro-influencers (10k-50k followers) often have higher engagement rates and are much more affordable than "Celebs."

sections.heading: What to include in your Brief
paragraphs: • The Hook: First 3 seconds of the video.
• Key Message: One thing they MUST say.
• Call to Action (CTA): Link in bio / Coupon code.

sections.heading: ROI Tracking
paragraphs: Use custom UTM links or unique discount codes for each influencer to track exactly who is driving sales.
Barter deals (Product for Post) still work great with hungry micro-influencers.
💡 Barter deals (Product for Post) still work great with hungry micro-influencers.

sections.heading: Fast Track Exit (FTE)
paragraphs: Strike off is a way to close a non-functional company without going through a long and expensive liquidation process.

sections.heading: Step-by-Step Closure
paragraphs: • Ensure company has NIL assets and liabilities.
• Company must be non-operational for at least 2 years.
• File Form STK-2 with a professional's certification.
• Closing all bank accounts and GST registrations first.

sections.heading: Directors Liability
paragraphs: Closing a company doesn't excuse directors from prior fraud or massive defaults. However, it does stop the clock on ongoing ROC compliance costs.
A "dormant" company is often more expensive than just closing it and starting fresh when you're ready again.
💡 A "dormant" company is often more expensive than just closing it and starting fresh when you're ready again.
